guitar.notes: Rich Robinson is well-known for vintage Les Pauls and Gretsch guitars in classic-rock revivalist style; reasonably documented though not singularly iconic.

tone.target: warm jangly edge-of-breakup southern rock clean
tone.profile: warm jangly edge-of-breakup southern rock clean
tone.summary: A warm, jangly southern rock tone achieved using a Comp for bite, followed by a mild OD boost into the UK 50/AC30-style amp, paired with a bright cab and spring reverb for chime.
